about_the_game:
Shove, stomp, slice, and shoot your way through an endless horde of zombies. 

Deaded The Runner is a roguelike small top down single player action shooter where you attempt to travel as deep as you can through the inner cities, all the while fending off an endless horde of Zombies.

You'll need to stay on your toes, you only have one life, with each kill granting a random item, adapt to the weapon you're given and make every action count.

The Zombies arent your only challenge. Guns may cost bullets but melee attacks will cost stamina! You'll have to manage drinking water and eating food to keep your stamina regeneration up. 

Deaded The Runner aims to keep combat as dynamic as possible so you will not be able to reload any weapons. Whatever is in the gun is what you get. Run out of ammo? simply throw it away so you can grab a new one!

The Further you travel, difficulty increases. How Far Will You Survive.
